args.question: Task: a coal-only belt to the boilers at base, plus a 3rd boiler and 2 steam engines. Please lay it as ghosts and give me exact coordinates. Current state: coal comes from my coal field (drills at ~49-55, 97-108) on a belt north to the iron area. At splitter (73,52.5) the left output runs north on x=72.5 and sideloads at (72.5,46.5) onto belt M's east lane (M = x=71.5 north to y=-25.5, then west along y=-25.5 to x=-29.5, north on x=-29.5 to y=-37.5, then east at (-28.5,-37.5), (-27.5,-37.5..-39.5), west to (-28.5,-39.5), north on x=-28.5 to -42.5). Boiler feeds: burner inserter (-29.5,-42.5) takes from belt (-28.5,-42.5) into the west boiler (-31.5,-43); burner inserter (-27.5,-40.5) takes from (-27.5,-39.5) into the east boiler (-27,-42.5). Overflow inserter (-28.5,-43.5) goes into chest (-28.5,-44.5). Problem: coal on M gets taken by the B2 feeder (50.5,-26.5) and the mall tap (~49,-24) into sink chests, so the boilers starve. Plan: take the x=72.5 coal branch off M and run it as its own belt to the boilers. Avoid the science block (x=9..56, y=-40..-26), the mall zone (x=8..51, y=-24..-16), copper belt y=-23.5, M itself, and claude-3's underground at (48.5,-24.5..-26.5). Then end M in a chest (provider) before the boilers, so only coal reaches the boiler segment. Also place a 3rd boiler + 2 engines next to the existing ones, fed from the same coal belt with a burner inserter, and water from the existing offshore pumps. Give me an item list (belts, undergrounds, inserters, boiler, engines, pipes, poles).
